titulo: The yes goes on the top line
caption:
The yes goes on the top line

The page asked Tuesday and buried the yes at the bottom. A gold tab hopped up to the top line.

The answer first and the reasons after means the reader can stop the moment they have what they need.

For whoever puts the answer on top and the story under it.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. At the right a paper titled Tue? with five lines and a gold tab that says yes sitting over its last line. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes trembles at the left, then its eyes go wide, it steps closer and the gold tab hops up the page and lands under the title, with a small sparkle. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me: let me explain first, to: answer first. then why.
